title: Overcoming Language Disparity in Online Content Classification with Multimodal Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the classification performance (F1 score, precision, recall) of pre-trained monolingual and multilingual language models on English text versus five non-English languages (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Hindi) across three social computing tasks, and quantifying the performance disparity using the root-mean-square deviation (RMSDen).
